title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: deep citations link to the cited part of Word and PowerPoint files
summary: Hold: Restricted Content Discovery is described too broadly as keeping a site out of Copilot. Microsoft says it does not affect experiences using content already in use, such as summarizing an open document; the roadmap facts and the documented control path and command otherwise check out.

claims.where: What's changing: neighbouring changes
claims.claim: The March 10, 2026 release notes describe a deep citation view for connector-based results, separate from the roadmap's file-passage links.
claims.quote: Copilot now provides inline citations for connector-based results, with a hover experience that displays a glance card summarizing the cited entity, and a deep citation view available when users select the citation for more detail.

claims.quote: Now, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF files open directly within Copilot Chat, allowing users to view documents alongside their chat session.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls: table
claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery is enabled at SharePoint admin center > Sites > Active sites > site > Settings > Restrict content from Microsoft Copilot.
claims.quote: In the SharePoint admin center, expand Sites and select Active sites. 2. Select the site you want to configure. 3. Open the Settings tab, and then turn Restrict content from Microsoft Copilot on.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance controls: table
claims.claim: Set-SPOSite -Identity <site-url> -RestrictContentOrgWideSearch $true enables Restricted Content Discovery.
claims.quote: Set-SPOSite -Identity <site-url> -RestrictContentOrgWideSearch $true

claims.where: controls[1].governs; Governance controls: prose
claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery is an existing site-level control limiting discovery of SharePoint content in organisation-wide search and Copilot responses.
claims.quote: Restricted Content Discovery helps you limit discovery of content from specific SharePoint sites, including recently interacted files, in organization-wide search results and Microsoft Copilot responses
claims.fix: After the description of Restricted Content Discovery, add: 'Microsoft's Copilot Search FAQ describes an exception for recent interaction, whereas the Restricted Content Discovery page says it includes recently interacted files.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/copilot-search-faq alongside https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/restricted-content-discovery.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls: table
claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery keeps a site out of Copilot.
claims.quote: Restricted Content Discovery doesn't affect experiences that operate on content that's already in use by the user, such as summarizing an open document.
claims.fix: Replace 'Keeps a site out of org-wide search and Copilot' in the row note and rendered table with 'Limits discovery of site content in organization-wide search and Copilot discovery scenarios; it does not affect experiences using content already in use, such as summarizing an open document.' Replace 'Restricted Content Discovery keeps a site out of Copilot' in Risk assessment with the same qualified statement. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/restricted-content-discovery.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Governance controls: prose and table
claims.claim: Restricted Content Discovery changes discoverability, not existing access permissions.
claims.quote: Restricted Content Discovery doesn't change existing permissions. Users who already have access to content can continue to access that content directly.
